gates.reason: No workflow in .github/workflows/ carries the flag — build.yml, docs-ci.yml, docs-deploy.yml and release.yml were each scanned and none has a `# verification: true` comment, and there is no verify.yml. Zero gates are discoverable by the mechanism /verify owns, which is exactly what issue #131 reports. Every entry below is therefore an optional, non-CI-gated local check, not a discovered gate.

gates.name: tools/Test-DesignState.ps1
gates.detail: Exit code 2. Findings (91), all Blocking=True: 46 [UnrecordedArtifact] (every .claude/commands/*.md, every tools/*.ps1, AGENTS.md, agent.md, README.md, design/00-brief.md, design/10-design.md, design/20-contract.md, design/30-slices.md, design/90-decisions.md, .claude/COMPANIONS.md, both .github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE files) each reported as 'tree artifact of kind X has no active unit record naming it as Anchor'; and 45 [LogEntryUnrecorded], one per decision heading in design/90-decisions.md, each 'log heading has no decision record naming it as Anchor'. Reported (32, Blocking=False): [MirrorStale] work/<n>: MirroredAt 'af3d73df05f2f58270fd874070a7c374a0a88dfa' is not the current commit '2625a6dd06188f977332d055d526252f8b48ca85' — one for each of the 32 WorkRef records. Could not evaluate (1): [ContractListUnreadable] SectionNotFound: design/20-contract.md. BASELINE: on main this same script also exits 2, but with Findings {} and Reported {} — its could-not-evaluate list is 'StateSetAbsent: design/state/ is missing or holds zero records' plus the same ContractListUnreadable, and its whole report is the single line 'StateSetAbsent: nothing to check.' So this branch does not change the exit code; it changes the checker from a vacuous skip into 91 blocking findings, because design/state/ now has content but holds only work/ records and no unit or decision records. This check is NOT CI-gated in this repository (see the discovery entry above).

gates.name: Invoke-Pester -Path tools -Output Detailed -PassThru
gates.detail: Tests completed in 132.6s. Tests Passed: 229, Failed: 25, Skipped: 0. TotalCount 254, PassedCount 229, FailedCount 25. Failing tests are concentrated in the design-state tooling suites, e.g. 'S4.6: unit/command/track and unit/document/agents-md exist and their closures are complete', 'S12.5: the check exits 0 against this repository, and names the largest closure and its size', 'reports ContractListUnreadable - uncomputed, never clean - when the table cannot be read', 'this repository's own table and its own enumeration agree', 'S16.1/S16.2: this repository has one Contract record per design/20-contract.md Public-surface entry', 'S7.2: -DryRun against the real repository writes nothing', and 'the "Run Pester tests" step carries a GH_TOKEN env, the same as "Check the design state against the tree"' (that last one asserts against a verify.yml this repository does not have). BASELINE: the same command on a clean worktree of main gives TotalCount 254, PassedCount 226, FailedCount 28. So this branch does not regress the suite — it moves it from 28 failures to 25, three fewer, because committing design/state/work/ satisfies tests that previously found no state set at all. Issue #158 records this suite as failing '32 of 254'; the current figure on main is 28, so that issue's count is itself stale. This suite is NOT CI-gated in this repository — no workflow runs Invoke-Pester, which is the second half of what #158 reports.

gates.detail:
Failed! - Failed: 1, Passed: 264, Skipped: 0, Total: 265, Duration: 1 m 2 s - SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.dll (net10.0). (SubZeroDev.Platform.GameEdge.Tests.dll passed 19/19.) The failure:

  Error Message:
   System.Net.Sockets.SocketException : nodename nor servname provided, or not known
  Stack Trace:
     at System.Net.Dns.GetHostEntryOrAddressesCore(String hostName, Boolean justAddresses, AddressFamily addressFamily, Nullable`1 activityOrDefault)
   at System.Net.Dns.GetHostAddresses(String hostNameOrAddress, AddressFamily family)
   at SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.BoundOnAnyNonLoopbackAddress(Int32 port) in tests/SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests/WorkerProbeTests.cs:line 100
   at SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests.WorkerProbeTests.The_worker_serves_its_probes_on_loopback_and_nowhere_else() in tests/SubZeroDev.Platform.Tests/WorkerProbeTests.cs:line 88
The test resolves this host's own name to enumerate non-loopback addresses; that resolution fails on this machine. It is an environment property, not a property of this branch — this branch changes no C# — but it was not re-run on main to confirm, so it is reported as a failure rather than dismissed.

gates.name: Docusaurus site build (docs-ci.yml, 'Verify Documentation Build' job)
gates.reason: `./docs.ps1 -BuildOnly` was run and exited 0, but it only builds the 'gameoflife-docs' Docker image — it does not invoke /template/scripts/docs-build.ps1, the status-page site build, the site merge, or the Pages artifact step that the docs-ci job runs. The real link-and-build verification therefore did not run locally; the docs-ci check on the pull request is where that answer comes from.

gates.name: Workload integration suites (replay, replay-edge, contention-one-instance, contention-two-instances, durable-replay, conformance, npm test)
gates.reason: Each requires the CI-orchestrated environment build.yml sets up — a started PostgreSQL durable store, a migrated schema, and the workload and edge running the documented way, plus the outbound-OTLP port blocking. None of that was provisioned locally, so none of these suites was attempted. The build.yml checks on the pull request are where these answers come from.
